scope: 133 quest entries including 42 optional guild chapters; typed activity targets, recommendations and prerequisite chains. Not a full economy simulation or observed human playtest.
changes: Recipe matching uses completion event and exact primary output, not suffixes.
New offers wait for required direct activity skills/levels, excluding the skill an introductory quest teaches. Accepted progress is retained.
Wildcard smithing routes to smithing rather than smelting.
The early granary meal uses shrimp instead of crops that need a later farming unlock.
limits: Delivery materials can have shop/loot/worker alternatives; this audit does not treat one production route as a mandatory skill gate.
Boss creature levels remain danger recommendations, not hard combat gates.
It does not measure time to gather every ingredient, every rare-drop wait or human enjoyment.
